speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Since you are 8 months old and having trouble feeding with a swollen belly, does your stomach make a gurgling or "whooshing" sound when you eat? Also, have you ever passed gas that sounds like a jet engine or had a bowel movement that looks like sand or has a foul smell?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Midgut Volvulus. Given the classic "jet engine" aspiration history (implied by gurgling), bilious vomiting (implied by distension/fussiness), and age, this is a surgical emergency. REQUEST IMAGES: Upper GI Series (Small Bowel Follow-Through).
